assumptions: Every module and script that lists hosts can import the registry from the same package. The membership table recorded from develop at 2a524884 is the behavior to preserve. The viewer HOSTS tuple is the only host-bearing part of the viewer vocabulary. Packaged hosts.json stays byte-identical.
compatibility: Additive module. Existing surfaces keep inputs, outputs, stored data and packaged assets; the alias claude and the canonical claude-code are both accepted as input for supported hosts. Rollback reverts the code change; no data changed.
domain: Host identifiers and their capability memberships in agent_braid/ and scripts/ at the recorded commit.
execution_contract: None. The registry runs no host, grants nothing and writes no record; a capability flag is not qualification, observation or authorization. executionAuthorization stays false wherever it exists.
observation_contract: The membership table and per-surface outputs recorded from develop at 2a524884 before the change; equality of sets and bytes after it. Equality shows preservation at that commit, not that the memberships are right, and not that any host works.

scientific_limits: Engineering, not a research protocol. Differential equality at one commit; no claim about host behavior, qualification or install success. A passing profile is not human review or approval.
scope: Specify one host registry module, agent_braid/host_registry.py, that names each supported host (codex, claude-code, opencode) once with its canonical identifier, the input alias claude, per-surface stored spellings and capability queries, replacing the scattered host lists with today's exact membership. Behavior preserving: no host or capability is added, no stored data or packaged asset changes. Documentation only: nothing implemented.
